qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for flywheel to crankshaft bolts on M60/1/M60/2/M62 Manual Transmission?
What torque should be applied to new micro-encapsulated screws on M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic transmissions?
What is the torque specification for new micro-encapsulated screws on all other transmissions?
Should screw retaining compound be used when installing flywheel to crankshaft bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: No, do not install with screw retaining compound. Bolts are a component part of the flywheel. Screw threads oiled.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic and all other transmissions for new micro-encapsulated screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic require 120 Nm while all others require 105 Nm, a difference of 15 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What component is referenced by code 1AZ in section 11 22?
What section and subsection covers flywheel specifications?
Are the flywheel bolts separate components or part of the flywheel assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The bolts are a component part of the flywheel, not separate components.
